name: Relaxo Footwears Ltd
tagline: Once-loved mass-footwear compounder now stuck in single-digit growth, held only as a small satellite position by its trusted-thread sponsor
business_overview: Relaxo is one of India's largest mass-market footwear manufacturers (Hawaii chappals, Sparx, Flite, Bahamas), historically a long-term compounder brand play but now facing intensifying competition and a multi-year growth slowdown.
fundamentals_narrative: A sharp quality deterioration from Relaxo's earlier compounder years: ROE has fallen to single digits (8.33%), ROCE is a modest 11.1%, and 5-year sales growth of just 2.75% confirms a genuine, multi-year growth stall rather than a one-quarter blip. Debt remains negligible, so this is a balance-sheet-clean but growth-starved business, not a solvency concern. Re-verified 2026-08-22: weak growth and mediocre returns confirmed — no recent-quarter improvement found to offset the poor trailing trend.
